subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and if so should the canonical surface be `tui.deliver` in `openclaw.json`?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and current docs intentionally frame delivery as an explicit launch-time choice.

options.title: Approve `tui.deliver`
options.body: Add a narrow boolean config default with schema/help/docs/tests while keeping explicit CLI flags highest precedence.

options.title: Keep Delivery Launch-Only
options.body: Leave delivery as an explicit per-session flag and close or retitle the request to document that product decision.

options.title: Use Runtime Preference
options.body: Reject a global config key and design a TUI-owned persisted preference or settings flow instead.

recommendation.title: Approve `tui.deliver`
recommendation.body: Add a narrow boolean config default with schema/help/docs/tests while keeping explicit CLI flags highest precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: This is mainly a config/default product decision, and steipete is the strongest available owner signal for the TUI and config-policy surface.
